### Added

- *(muster)* Ask for the SigV4 operating region and send request metadata as requestMeta in [#3650](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3650) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(review-queue)* Add Hive's Reviews tab with Post to Slack in [#3658](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3658) by [@fhielpos](https://github.com/fhielpos)
- *(plans)* Start Hive on the reader's own team in [#3659](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3659) by [@fhielpos](https://github.com/fhielpos)

### Fixed

- *(agent-platform)* Stop sending people to the kagent UI in [#3656](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3656) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(agent-platform)* Show the App sign-in when a workspace start needs a grant, and never fail a start silently in [#3657](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3657) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
